h1.cap: Everyone in that room was right... and everyone was wrong.

n2.cap: Rumi tells this story in the Masnavi.

n3.cap: An elephant in a dark room. Nobody can see it... so they touch it.

q1.cap: "One felt its trunk, and declared that the beast resembled a water-pipe."

n4.cap: Another felt the ear... a large fan. The leg... a pillar. The back... a great throne.

n5.cap: At work, a launch flops. Sales blames the price. Support... the bugs. Design... the look.

n6.cap: Each one holds a piece... and calls it the whole elephant.

n7.cap: Rumi says our senses work like the palm of a hand.

q2.cap: "The whole of the object is not grasped in the palm."

n8.cap: The twist? You're in that room too. Your piece always feels like the whole.

n9.cap: Before tonight, in one disagreement, ask... what are you seeing that I'm not?

n10.cap: Which piece are you holding right now? Tell me below.

n11.cap: Follow Awazzzz... and see the whole elephant.
